text:
Angels dressed in gold, in purple and hyacinth.

Genius and love are easy duties.


I kneaded only clay and from it drew gold.


He carried in his gaze the spirit of the heart.

In Paris, his desert, living exposed to the weather,

Strong as a beast and free as a God.

translation.title: Pride
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the fragmentary grandeur of pride, alchemy, Paris as desert, and godlike freedom.
